name: browser-use
headline: Build Claude Skills with precise research
short_description: Claude Skill Kit enables operations teams to build comprehensive AI skills based on research. It connects to Claude AI for generating and refining skills, benefiting teams needing custom automation workflows.
author: rfxlamia

sections.overview:
SkillKit is a toolkit designed for creating and validating custom skills that extend AI agent functionality across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and Codex. The toolkit includes two core skills: a meta-skill for creating new skills and subagents with dual-mode validation (fast or full workflow), and a help skill for understanding skill concepts and best practices. SkillKit includes 14 Python automation scripts for initialization, validation, token estimation, security scanning, test generation, and quality scoring. It supports progressive disclosure through auto-splitting, workflow pattern detection, and document-to-skill migration. The toolkit enforces a quality target of 9.0+/10 through 5-layer validation and multi-proposal generation, making it suitable for teams building custom automation workflows.
Create reusable skills to extend AI agent capabilities for team workflows
Validate and quality-check custom skills before deployment
Convert existing documentation into structured AI agent skills
Generate automated tests and security scans for skill packages
